annotations.title: Check an EU VAT number in VIES

description:
Check whether a VAT number was valid for intra-EU transactions according
to VIES, the European Commission's VAT Information Exchange System, on
request_date. Results are cached for 24 hours. Use it when the user asks
whether a VAT number (NIF-IVA) is valid for intra-EU trade. For a Spanish
NIF, use company_by_nif to look for a company with that NIF in our registry.

Returns JSON {vat_number, country_code, number, valid, request_date, source,
note}. Relay note as given: the check does not identify the holder, and a
negative result says nothing about the domestic tax identifier.
invalid_input true: relay tell_the_user. error vies_unavailable or
vat_check_rate_limited: the check could not be made now; do not call the
number valid or invalid.

Read-only. Needs the basic plan or higher: send your API key in the
X-API-Key header (https://bormeapi.com/account).

vat_number.description: EU VAT number with its two-letter country code, e.g. ESA28015865 or DE123456789. Spaces, dots and hyphens are ignored; GR is read as EL; a Spanish NIF without a prefix is checked as ES.
vat_number.title: Vat Number
